issuer.name: AIAD Templates (unofficial, not published by the brand)

offers.title: Apple AirPods Pro 3
offers.summary: Noise-cancelling earbuds with Apple H2 chip, Bluetooth 5.3 and a built-in heart rate sensor. Up to 8 hours per charge with ANC on, up to 24 hours with the case. Earbuds and case rated IP57.

specs.name: case_charging
specs.value: USB-C, MagSafe, Qi, Apple Watch charger

claims.statement: Up to 8 hours of listening per charge with ANC on
Earbuds and charging case rated IP57

suitable_for: iPhone users who want noise cancelling
Workouts in sweat or rain, with heart rate tracking in the Fitness app
not_suitable_for: Android users: heart rate tracking needs an iPhone running iOS 26 or later, and many other features are Apple-only
Listeners who want LDAC or aptX high-resolution Bluetooth codecs
Swimming: IP57 is not rated for swimming

offers.title: Sony WF-1000XM6
offers.summary: Noise-cancelling earbuds with 8.4 mm drivers, Bluetooth 5.3, LDAC and multipoint connection. Up to 8 hours per charge with noise cancelling on, up to 24 hours with the case. Rated IPX4.

specs.name: quick_charge
specs.value: 5 min charge for about 60 min playback

claims.statement: Up to 8 hours per charge with noise cancelling on

suitable_for: Android users who want LDAC high-resolution audio
People who switch between a phone and a laptop (multipoint)
not_suitable_for: iPhone users who want LDAC: iPhone does not support LDAC
Dusty environments or swimming: IPX4 covers splashes only and has no dust rating
